template.name: Shelf testing — Decipher
template.description: A native product choice on a realistic granola shelf with controlled placements and availability.
template.instructions: Use ShelfTesting in the main slot with a valid unique label (example ShelfPick). Each instance owns its prefixed native assignment, metadata and choice fields and supplies its own page breaks. Use one shelf question per page. Keep the base's single shared CSS/JavaScript pair and server design loader. Upload shelf-design-v1.dat as a root/system file and granola-atlas.png as a static file before compiling. Preserve autosave=1 and each automatic initialization submission so the random native version persists before choices are displayed. Do not assign versions from URL variables or randomize placements in JavaScript. Preserve required native choice validation, stable row labels p101–p106 and export codes 101–106; unavailable products retain their shelf spot but cannot be chosen. Preserve exported design ID/version, placement/availability/price metadata and derived selected product fields. Keep the concise research question, choice interaction and neutral Continue. Do not add branded headers, footers, welcome/review pages, Save/buy/checkout controls, Back or Undo. This is a fixed illustrative design, not a statistically optimized conjoint. Changes to products, prices, layout counts or design require corresponding source/asset changes and native verification.
